chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ali ibn Muhammad al-Qasani, from Abu Ayyub al-Madani, from Suleiman ibn Ja'far al-Ja'fari, from Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him)
That the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) liked looking at the green citron and the red apple.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) enjoy looking at?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) highlights the Prophet’s appreciation for natural beauty, specifically green citrons and red apples, reflecting the Shia concept of *tazkiyah* (purification) through sensory enjoyment of God’s creation. Historically, this hadith is often cited in discussions on *adab* (etiquette) and the permissibility of deriving pleasure from permissible (*halal*) worldly things, countering ascetic extremes. It underscores the balance between spiritual devotion and worldly appreciation in the Prophetic character.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ali Bin Muhammad Al Qasany, from Abu Ayoub Al Madainy, from Suleyman Bin Ja’far Al Ja’fary,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> liked looking at the green Citron and the red Apple’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Ali ibn Muhammad al-Qasaniy from abu Ayyub al-Madiniy from Sulayman ibn Ja‘far al-Ja‘fariy who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, al-Rida’, has said that
the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, liked to look at the green citron and red apple.’”
